sections.heading: The science behind high-quality PDF compression.
body: Unoptimized PDFs often carry heavy hidden bloat: redundant font subsets, uncompressed thumbnail caches, thumbnail XML metadata, and high-DPI camera rasters.

Zcompressor isolates background raster assets and re-encodes image streams using optimal JPEG color space downsampling while preserving document vector text layers intact. This produces smaller files that look visually indistinguishable from the original.

faq.q: Will my text look blurry after compression?
faq.a: No! True PDF text is stored as vector glyphs. Zcompressor never converts vector text into bitmap images, so your text stays pin-sharp at any zoom level.
